name: agentic-slop
description: Personal agentic toolkit: proposal shaping and verified delivery, plus a research library, as two independently installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: slop-eng
plugins.description: Shape proposals and deliver verified, authorized changes through a PR, with complexity-routed coder/writer production and fresh QA or auditor validation. Uses slop-lib when installed; works without it.

plugins.name: slop-lib
plugins.description: Research with provenance and ask the existing Markdown library, with researcher, librarian, scribe, and fresh clerk validation. Standalone — installable with or without slop-eng.
